Product details

The unique taste of Lotus Biscoff also comes in a sandwich Biscuit. Two delicious crunchy Biscoff Biscuits with a smooth cream filling in between. Enjoy the delicious caramelised taste of this filled Biscuit wherever and whenever you want. Perfect for sharing with your friends and family! Made with non-GMO ingredients, Lotus Biscoff Biscuits are vegan friendly and contain no artificial flavours or colors.
  • A delicious, caramelised crunchy biscuit on the outside, with a smooth creamy Vanilla filling on the inside.

  • Comes in a handy sharing pack

  • No colours

  • No added flavours

  • Suitable for vegetarians.
